title: Creator onboarding release gate
objective: Demonstrate that a creator can collect recommendations, approve safe work, verify the result, and roll back the candidate.

items.title: Audit the creator workflow
items.instructions: Inspect the documented local workflow in read-only mode. Report concrete gaps without editing files.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding cites a path, command, or bounded observation.
Remote capability is not represented as local filesystem access.

items.title: Validate accepted corrections
items.instructions: Evaluate the resulting tree against the acceptance checklist. Do not modify the workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Automated checks include exact command and exit code.
Unrun live checks remain not-run or blocked.
